info.description: The Star Wars Databank API provides access to a comprehensive collection of data related to the Star Wars universe including characters, droids, creatures, locations, organizations, species, and vehicles. It is a RESTful API that presents official information derived directly from the Star Wars Databank, allowing users to explore and interact with the vast lore of the saga.
